title: .to_string() on string literals should be .to_owned()
description: Multiple default-value functions across auth/config.rs, imap/config.rs, and reader/config.rs use "literal".to_string() (e.g. "email".to_string(), "info".to_string(), "PLAIN".to_string(), "localhost".to_string()). Clippy lint: clippy::str_to_string. The .to_string() path goes through fmt::Display formatting; .to_owned() or String::from() is the direct heap-allocating conversion from a string literal. There are at least 8 instances across the three files.
